subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should the Codex/OpenAI OAuth image-generation route intentionally reject each response image above the configured per-image budget, including failing a response when every returned image exceeds that budget?
rationale: The patch is deliberately fail-closed on an externally owned Codex/OAuth response boundary, and repository policy requires direct sibling-Codex contract inspection before accepting that compatibility and availability tradeoff.

options.title: Confirm the fail-closed contract
options.body: Inspect the exact Codex response implementation and accept the existing-limit per-image rejection behavior if it is the intended safety boundary.

options.title: Keep aggregate-only behavior
options.body: Retain the current aggregate JSON limit and do not apply the per-image parser guard to the Codex/OAuth route until a different compatibility policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Confirm the fail-closed contract
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact Codex response implementation and accept the existing-limit per-image rejection behavior if it is the intended safety boundary.
